result.line: No contracts on avalanche: Unit is a 2-of-3 MPC guardian bridge (docs.hyperunit.xyz); the only avalanche address is the treasury EOA 0x84e49dDcAD2eBFE7474Fa7A3d3eb1fe8bC103A16 (eth_getCode=0x, nonce 1030, 43,549.6 AVAX = $310,103 at $7.1207 AVAX, coins.llama.fi, matching the $303k TVL); deposits are plain AVAX transfers to derived addresses and withdrawals are guardian-broadcast batches, so there is no callable function and no reward.
